title: Read documents using the Vision framework
description: Learn about the latest advancements in the Vision framework. We’ll introduce RecognizeDocumentsRequest, and how you can use it to read lines of text and group them into paragraphs, read tables, etc. And we’ll also dive into camera lens smudge detection, and how to identify potentially smudged images in photo libraries or your own camera capture pipeline.
